description: A trade account (account, or the wallet's own): its owner, its agent and the agent's limits (with today's loss against its daily loss budget and what that still lets the agent do: opens, deposit withdrawals and trigger-sets while it has room; closes and top-ups always), the USDG and stock it holds, its shorts and leveraged longs with their LTV (Morpho's own), how much of their limit each uses and the price that liquidates it, which positions have no trigger, every live trigger with its distance from the price now, who can do what, and the market clock. Triggers do not fire while the stock market is shut or the feed has not printed within 25 hours; a price crossed while it is shut (a weekend, a holiday) fires once the market opens again, at the price the feed prints then, within the trigger's slip, and after a gap that price can be well past the trigger's.

account.description: A trade account's address (default: the wallet's own, as its owner; an agent gives its owner's account)

wallet.description: The account's owner (when account is not given), or a wallet to say whether it is the owner or the agent
